metadata.question: Are there more than two lakes (larger than 25 km square) in the region centered at coordinates (7.578886, 38.602260) within a 30 km radius, based on 2022 data?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use JRC Global Surface Water dataset for 2022 or latest available data - Region: Point at (7.578886, 38.602260) with 30 km radius buffer - Need to identify water bodies and calculate their areas 2. Masking strategy: - Use water occurrence or permanent water layers - Filter for areas that are consistently water (high occurrence percentage) - Need to identify distinct lake objects and calculate their areas 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (B): Less than or equal to 2 lakes > 25 km² - Yes (A): More than 2 lakes > 25 km² - C1: No data available for the region - C2: No valid water pixels after processing - C3: Calculation fails or returns invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Define geometry and parameters const centerPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([7.578886, 38.602260]); const region = centerPoint.buffer(30000); // 30 km radius const minLakeArea = 25e6; // 25 km² in square meters // 2. Load JRC Global Surface Water dataset const gsw = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater'); // Check if data exists const occurrence = gsw.select('occurrence'); const testCount = occurrence.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('occurrence'); const pixelCount = await testCount.getInfo(); if (pixelCount === 0 || pixelCount === null) { console.log('No surface water data available for region.'); console.log('C1'); return; } console.log(`Total pixels in region: ${pixelCount}`); // 3. Identify permanent water bodies (occurrence > 75%) const waterMask = occurrence.gt(75); // Count valid water pixels const waterPixelCount = await waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('occurrence').getInfo(); if (waterPixelCount === 0 || waterPixelCount === null) { console.log('No permanent water pixels found.'); console.log('B'); return; } console.log(`Water pixels found: ${waterPixelCount}`); // 4. Identify connected water bodies using connectedPixelCount const waterBodies = waterMask.selfMask(); const connected = waterBodies.connectedPixelCount({ maxSize: 10000, eightConnected: false }); // Calculate area of each connected component (pixel count * 900 m² for 30m resolution) const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const waterArea = connected.multiply(pixelArea).divide(1e6); // Convert to km² // 5. Mask to only keep lakes larger than 25 km² const largeLakes = waterArea.updateMask(waterArea.gte(25)); // Count distinct large lakes using reduceToVectors const vectors = largeLakes.reduceToVectors({ geometry: region, scale: 3000, geometryType: 'polygon', maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }); const lakeCount = await vectors.size().getInfo(); if (lakeCount === null || lakeCount === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Number of lakes > 25 km²: ${lakeCount}`); // 6. Final answer if (lakeCount > 2) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (error) { console.log(`Error: ${error.message}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
